info.title: NOX Energy API - Connections
info.description:
# Connections API Documentation

Connect a user's account at a provider (a device brand or a utility) to NOX Energy, and manage
that access.

## Authentication

1. Get your API key from [NOX Energy](mailto:support@nox.energy).
2. Include the API key in your API calls with the header: `x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY`.

Base URL: [https://api.nox.energy](https://api.nox.energy)

get.description:
Get the connections of a user: through which providers NOX reaches the user's assets, and which
assets each connection gives access to. A user without connections gets an empty list.

post.summary: Connect a user you already identify
post.description:
Connect a user's assets directly by their identifier at your platform, without the user going
through the connect flow.

**Only for manufacturer partners**: your platform is the provider of the connection. Other API
keys get `403`. Energy suppliers connect users with `POST /v2/connections/link` instead.

example.detail: Connections are not available in the sandbox.

Start the connect flow for a user. Send the user to the returned `link_url`: they pick their
provider, grant NOX access, and return to your `redirect_url`.

Get the household the user's connections belong to. It exists once the user has connected
something, so a user without connections gets `404`.
